chunks: It is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition) to turn in six prayers, and they are: the first rak'ah of salat al-layl, the single rak'ah of witr, the first rak'ah of the two rak'ahs of zawal, the first rak'ah of the two rak'ahs of ihram, the first rak'ah of the nawafil of maghrib, and the first rak'ah of the obligatory prayer. Thus my father, may Allah be pleased with him, mentioned it in his letter to me.

key_terms.التَّوَجُّهُ: turning or directing oneself in the manner intended in the prayer context
key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the established sunnah (prophetic tradition) practice being described
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الزَّوَالِ: the two rak'ahs associated with zawal

ai.seo_question: In which prayers is turning prescribed as part of the sunnah?
ai.summary: This report states a sunnah practice concerning turning in six specific prayers. It preserves a juristic teaching transmitted in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih and attributes it to the author's father in his written instruction.
